language.title: Language
language.footer: System follows your device’s language. Changes apply immediately.
theme.title: Theme
theme.footer: System follows your device’s light or dark appearance.
accounts.switchHint: Tap an account to switch to it. Each account keeps its own saved data.
accounts.signedOutLocally: Signed out on this device. GitHub access is revoked the next time you’re online.
accounts.confirmMessage: GH Mobile+ revokes its access on GitHub and deletes saved data and drafts for the account from this device.
lock.toggle: Require Face ID, Touch ID, or passcode
lock.unavailable: This device doesn’t offer a screen lock to the browser, so app lock can’t be turned on.
lock.failed: App lock wasn’t turned on. Try again.
lock.idleFooter: The app locks when you return after being away this long, and every time it starts.
badge.toggle: Show unread count on the app icon
badge.footer: Turning this on asks for notification permission, which iPhone requires for icon badges. The count updates while the app is open; GH Mobile+ doesn’t send notifications.
offline.footerOn: Content you’ve viewed, including from private repositories, is saved on this device for up to 7 days so you can read it offline. Signing out deletes it.
offline.footerOff: Only basic profile information is saved for offline reading, including profiles in user search results. Turning this off removes other cached results for every account on this device.
about.notAffiliated: GH Mobile+ is not affiliated with or endorsed by GitHub, Inc.
about.sourcePending: The link appears here once the project is published.
about.privacyDetail: The app talks only to GitHub and to this site’s sign-in service.
about.thirdPartyFooter.one: GH Mobile+ is built with {count} open-source package. Tap one to read its license.
about.thirdPartyFooter.other: GH Mobile+ is built with {count} open-source packages. Tap one to read its license.
help.intro: Known limitations of GH Mobile+, and what to do about them.
help.suspended.title: You may need to sign in again after the app was suspended
help.suspended.body: If your phone suspends the app at the exact moment it renews your session with GitHub, the renewed session is lost. Sign in again to continue; nothing else is affected.
help.push.title: No push notifications
help.push.body: Notifications and the app icon badge update while the app is open.
help.feed.title: The activity feed can be delayed
help.feed.body: GitHub’s events feed can lag from 30 seconds to 6 hours, keeps at most 300 events from the last 30 days, and doesn’t include starred repositories.
help.iosSignIn.title: On iPhone, the Home Screen app signs in separately
help.iosSignIn.body: The installed app keeps its own cookies, separate from Safari, so GitHub may ask you to sign in to github.com again the first time.
help.undo.title: Done and Mark read wait 5 seconds
help.undo.body: GitHub can’t undo Done or Mark read, so GH Mobile+ sends them after the 5-second undo window. If you close the app within that window, the thread stays unread on GitHub.
help.offline.title: Offline is read-only
help.offline.body: Without a connection you can read what you’ve already opened, but you can’t comment, merge or change anything. Drafts are kept on this device until you’re back online.
help.codeSearch.title: Code search uses GitHub’s API syntax
help.codeSearch.body: Code search goes through GitHub’s API, which has its own query syntax and a lower rate limit, so results can differ from github.com.
help.lock.title: App lock is a privacy screen
help.org.title: Some organizations restrict third-party apps
help.org.body: An organization can block apps it hasn’t approved, or require single sign-on. GH Mobile+ then explains what’s blocked and links to GitHub, where you can request approval or authorize single sign-on.
